summary: PrizePicks Packs owned the day. Their post about a $25 pack pulling a $2.8M Dylan Harper card got 1,053 likes and 507k impressions, and other users were already complaining about bad $1 and $100 packs. GameStop Power Packs launched One Piece Platinum Series 2, and the new One Piece TCG set sold out on day one, which annoyed collectors. Solflare Packs talk was steady and positive, led by @LipeSolana's first-rare post and a 2-pack giveaway, but it still comes mostly from small crypto community accounts.

top_posts.text: Cam really just made $2.8M on PrizePicks Packs 😱 He's decided to SELL the Dylan Harper grail and cash in. Three other $2M + grails are still in packs. Does Flagg, Kon, or Pikachu get pulled next? 👀
top_posts.why_it_matters: 507k impressions. A mainstream sports betting brand is selling digital packs to non-crypto fans with a huge 'grail' hook. They also lean on sell-back, like we do.

top_posts.text: Treasure isn't always gold. 🏴‍☠️ The 2026 One Piece Platinum Series 2 Power Pack is now available online and at GameStop stores nationwide.
top_posts.why_it_matters: 13.2k impressions. GameStop is pushing One Piece packs online and in stores, right into a category we also have.

top_posts.text: another one piece tcg set another wave of disappointment where its sold out everywhere already day 1 and getting resold elsewhere for double the price
top_posts.why_it_matters: 2.7k impressions. Sold-out retail and resellers are the daily One Piece complaint. Packs you can open anytime answer it.

top_posts.text: OH MY GOD!! My first RARE! Thank you, @solflare Packs! To celebrate this beautiful pull and an amazing Friday, I'm thinking about hosting a GIVEAWAY soon!
top_posts.why_it_matters: 3.9k impressions. Most-seen Solflare Packs pull post of the day; the creator followed up with a giveaway.

top_posts.text: the worst part of opening card packs has never been the bad pull. it is what happens after. you rip a pack, get cards you do not want, and now you have to list them, wait for buyers, pack them, ship them. most people just let them sit in a drawer.
top_posts.why_it_matters: Names a real pain we already solve: sell back within 72 hours or keep it in the wallet. The post promotes @catchback_cards.

top_posts.text: Someone paid $25 for a PrizePicks pack and pulled a card valued at $2.88M. The odds: about 1 Grail per $60M in packs sold. How @PrizePicks can afford it, who really wins, the legal fight over repacks, and where the hobby is heading.
top_posts.why_it_matters: 4.2k impressions. People are starting to ask about real odds and the legal side of repacks. Showing odds up front matters.

top_posts.text: PSA Value grading is BACK. 💰 $39.99 per card (previously $32.99) ⏳ 90–100 business days 📉 Backlog down to 7.2M cards Value Bulk remains suspended. At $40 per card, is grading modern Pokémon cards still worth it?
top_posts.why_it_matters: Low reach, but a clear data point: PSA grading went up in price and still takes 90–100 business days. Our cards come already graded.

top_posts.text: What I would rip again: One Piece Jurassic Park TCG Absolute K League Bo Jackson Battle Arena KPop Demon Hunters What I wouldn't rip again: Pitch Kings - I watched 10 boxes ripped after mine and they were all bad.
top_posts.why_it_matters: 'Would rip again / wouldn't' list is an easy, light format we could borrow with our own categories.

sources_note: X search via the x connector, posts from 2026-10-30 09:00 UTC to 2026-10-31 09:00 UTC, 9 post searches, 1 post lookup and 1 X news search. Engagement numbers are copied from the X API at scan time. The PrizePicks $2.8M pull comes from PrizePicks' own post; the Collector Crypt revenue rank is an unverified claim from a small account; Pudgy Penguins and Battle Deck items are X news summaries (Grok-written). Payments talk was thin: card and Apple Pay searches returned mostly carding spam and personal credit-card-debt jokes, which were skipped. @LipeSolana's giveaway is listed as a mention only. @Sinsonx's '25 to 259' and @KryptoSenora's 'addictive' wording are not framing we should echo. Restock bots (e.g. PokeWatchCanada, restockd_ping), #ad deal accounts, giveaway farms, token shills and carding posts were skipped. Creators already in collector-base.csv or earlier daily files were excluded. The One Piece idea is marked for legal check because it mentions odds.
